annotations.text:
Where the map should sit.
A keeps every row where it is; B reads louder but pushes the charts and the section block down about ten rows.
Both options carry the same new content: divisions on the map, and a line saying the unit costs are statewide while the Middle/West/East columns in Pay_Items sit empty.

Proposed next step: same placement, read as a dashboard.
Six KPI tiles, bars inside the present-worth column, and a unit-cost benchmark. Nothing moves rows; every value already exists in a cell.
